{{Quote|Give me that one's sword.|The Falleen trying to claim Vizsla's Darksaber|<ref name="Eminence (episode)">{{TCW|Eminence (episode)}}</ref>}}
An [[Falleen/Legends|Falleen]] male was part of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] '''leadership''' stationed in a [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|facility]] on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].

==History==
After [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] and [[Savage Opress/Legends|Savage Opress]] made an [[Shadow Collective/Legends|alliance]] with the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]], their first [[Mission to Mustafar (Death Watch)/Legends|journey]] lead to [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]] to recruit the members of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. [[Ziton Moj/Legends|Ziton Moj]], [[Captain of the Guard/Legends|Captain of the Guard]] led them into the [[Black Sun fortress/Legends|facility]], where they wanted to talk with the leader [[Xomit Grunseit/Legends|Xomit Grunseit]]. Grunseit, along with the rest of the leadership, refused to join, and ordered his [[Black Sun foot soldier/Legends|guards]] to kill them, and take their weapons and ships. This leader smiled and asked the guards to give him the "[[Darksaber/Legends|sword]]" of [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]]. However, the brothers and Vizsla easily defeated the guards, and after Grunseit refused to join again, Opress threw his [[Savage Opress's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and [[Sai cha/Legends|decapitated]] all the members, including this one.

==Behind the scenes==
The Black Sun leader was voiced by [[Dave Filoni]], who is the supervising director of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|the series]].
